title: Grateful Dead Live at Nassau Veterans Memorial Coliseum on 1973-09-08

ai_review.summary: A solid soundboard capture of the 9/8/73 show, highlighted by a transcendent China Cat → I Know You Rider transition and stand‑outs like Tennessee Jed, Eyes and Truckin'.
ai_review.review: The GoodBear‑edited SBD source is generally well balanced with hiss reduction, though one listener notes it could use more high‑end sparkle. Musically the concert is praised for its jazzy tightness, strong first‑set flow and a second set packed with favorites such as Tennessee Jed, Brown‑Eyed Women, Eyes, Greatest Story Ever Told and Truckin', while a few fans find the opening half uneven.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers rate the performance 4‑5 stars and cite many standout songs; recording is described as good but with minor tonal issues, yielding an overall rating just above four.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Balanced L‑R mix and hiss reduction noted; one reviewer mentions the high‑end frequencies could be brighter.

standout_songs: China Cat Sunflower > I Know You Rider
show_quality.setlist_flow: First set described as solid but a bit bumpy; second set praised for jazzy tightness and strong song transitions, especially the China Cat → I Know You Rider segue.

band_member_comments.Keys: Keith Godchaux takes vocal lead on a few numbers – fans note his singing but wish he sang more.
